subject: RE: NovaHealth MAP draft + pricing approval
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-25T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: NovaHealth - discovery follow-up & MAP draft

Thanks Marissa / David — great call today. Quick recap and asks from our side:

TL;DR: We like Redwood's latency/cost profile. Need a MAP with clear milestones, ownership, and a draft commercial so our procurement can evaluate. Budget is constrained this quarter; any flexibility on pricing or onboarding credits will help accelerate approval.

Recap & priorities:
- POC (functional) — 4 weeks; vendor to provide sandbox and sample workload testing
- Security review — SOC-2 evidence and data flow diagram; internal security will take ~2 weeks once they have docs
- Procurement & legal review — target 3-4 weeks after commercial terms submitted
- Target production go-live: mid-May (preferred)

Dependencies:
- Customer to provide data sample and access to dev environment (we'll assign an engineer)
- Redwood to provide MAP document and pricing summary for procurement

Asks:
1) Please send MAP draft and a recommended commercial (commit level + any available credits/discounts).
2) Can you confirm timeline to get SOC-2 artefacts and an initial sandbox for the POC?
3) Any chance of a pilot credit or onboarding discount to hit a May go-live?

I've copied Procurement on this thread. Thanks — we'll review the MAP and get back with any follow-up Qs.

— Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Integrations, NovaHealth
alex.johnson@novahealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novahealth.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-25T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: NovaHealth - MAP draft + pricing summary (per today's call)

Alex — thanks for the time today. Attaching a MAP draft (NovaHealth_MAP_draft_v2.xlsx) and a short pricing summary that maps to the recommended commit levels (Redwood_pricing_summary.pdf).

High level MAP (draft):
- Milestone 1: Sandbox & initial validation (owner: Redwood SE / David) — Target start: 2026-04-01, duration: 2 weeks
- Milestone 2: POC completion (owner: NovaHealth + Redwood SE) — Target complete: 2026-04-21
- Milestone 3: Security review & sign-off (owner: NovaHealth security + Redwood compliance) — Target complete: 2026-05-05
- Milestone 4: Commercial & procurement sign-off (owner: NovaHealth procurement + Redwood sales) — Target sign-off: 2026-05-12
- Milestone 5: Production enablement (owner: Redwood ops + NovaHealth infra) — Target go-live: 2026-05-15

Responsibilities (examples in attached MAP):
- Redwood: provide sandbox credentials, test prompts, SOC-2 evidence, weekly check-ins, and a technical onboarding plan
- NovaHealth: provide data sample, assign integration engineer, complete security questionnaire

Pricing notes (from the attached summary):
- Recommended commit: 12 months / $360,000 committed spend (monthly invoicing)
- List-equivalent discount tiers shown; we have flexibility for onboarding credits or promotional discounts to assist procurement.

Next steps:
1) Please review attached MAP and mark any timeline changes or owner edits.
2) Procurement — if you can share a wishlist (target discount / credit ask), we can escalate for exec pricing approval.
3) Propose we reconvene for a short follow-up on 2026-03-31 or 2026-04-01 to finalize the MAP and confirm the POC start.

Attachments: NovaHealth_MAP_draft_v2.xlsx, Redwood_pricing_summary.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novahealth.com>
Date: 2026-03-26T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: NovaHealth - MAP draft + pricing summary (per today's call)

Adding a few technical clarifications for the MAP and POC plan:

- Sandbox: We'll provision a sandbox instance in us-west with a 2 vGPU setup (NVIDIA A10G equivalent) for the POC. Estimated readiness: 5 business days after data/sample received.
- Data requirements: sample payloads (anonymized) + 1 week's traffic profile will be enough for initial validation.
- Security artefacts: SOC2 Type II report + network/data flow diagram — I'll attach the pointer once I confirm with Compliance. Expect ~48 hours to gather the docs.
- Acceptance criteria for POC: 1) latency SLOs < 250ms for 95th percentile on our test prompts, 2) output quality threshold on provided prompt set, 3) integration stability across 2k concurrent requests simulated.

I'll update the attached MAP with these technical dependencies and acceptance criteria.

— David
David Kim
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.com

From: Procurement <procurement@novahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novahealth.com>
Date: 2026-03-27T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NovaHealth - MAP draft + pricing summary (procurement questions)

Marissa — thanks for the MAP. A few procurement items to clarify before we can present to legal:

1) Can you provide standard contract term length options and cancellation terms?
2) Is there a security addendum we can route through our legal team?
3) On pricing — the $360k commit is above our preliminary allocation. Is there a smaller pilot (3 months) with credits that scales to the larger commit on successful POC?

If you can provide these options this week we can try to keep momentum toward a mid-May target.

— Procurement Team, NovaHealth

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-29T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: FW: NovaHealth - MAP draft + pricing approval needed

Rishi — forwarding the thread. Quick background: NovaHealth is a mid-market healthcare ISV; they want to push to production mid-May and are budget-constrained. Procurement asked about a smaller pilot + credits. Proposed commercial I discussed with Alex is: 12-month commit $360k with a 25% promotional discount up front and $20k onboarding credit to accelerate procurement. If we can offer a 25% discount + credits we think we can close by mid-May.

Ask: Can you approve a promotional discount at the 25% level and $20k onboarding credit for this deal? We can structure the contract so the promotional discount is contingent on signed 12-month commit and invoice schedule. If 25% is not possible, what's the maximum we can offer without additional approvals? Need decision by 2026-03-31 to keep procurement on schedule.

Relevant link: https://hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-2026-0098 (includes ARR math and pricing options).

Pricing summary (attached): Redwood_pricing_summary.pdf — highlights shown below for quick review:
- List price equivalent: $480k/year
- Proposed commit: $360k/year (25% off list)
- Requested credits: $20k onboarding credit

I'll be available all day Thurs/Friday for a quick call if helpful.

Thanks — Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-30T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: NovaHealth - MAP draft + pricing approval needed

Marissa — thanks for the clear ask and the context. Approve a promotional discount of 20% off list + $15,000 onboarding credit for NovaHealth, contingent on:
1) Signed 12-month commit at the $360k committed spend (we'll reflect discount in the SOW)
2) Procurement / legal confirm standard terms (we'll provide security addendum and T&Cs)
3) You aim to keep final sign-off by 2026-05-12 for the planned go-live on 2026-05-15.

Please capture these terms in the MAP/commercial document and loop me in once you have the redline from NovaHealth so I can approve any final adjustments. If Marissa can push for a stronger case for 25% (e.g., logo, case study commitment, higher initial invoice), we can revisit an additional 5% as a stretch.

Approved: 20% + $15k credit. Proceed.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
